Q01.summary: Lists files under base_dir by recursively collecting non-excluded subdirectory glob patterns (skipping excluded or looping symlinks) and globbing their direct children, falling back to base_dir/**/*.

Q02.summary: Refreshes the mark when the watched file has grown (resetting the deadline to now+limit) and reports whether the clock has passed the current deadline.

Q03.summary: Prints a count header for ledger entries, lists them per group with statuses and reasons, then advises rerunning for unevaluated entries and pruning prunable ones; returns 0.

Q04.summary: Unless the status is allowed, raises the Faraday error class matching the response status (custom 4xx, 407 proxy, generic client/server, nil) with response (and optionally request) details.

Q05.summary: Raises if the handler stack is frozen, resolves the index (integer or existing handler), and inserts a new Handler built from the remaining args at that position.

Q06.summary: Returns whether some other fragment in the same file spans this fragment's start line through its end line (including heredoc closing lines).

Q07.summary: In a transaction creates the organization with invited/owner memberships, moves the selected gems to it, marks onboarding completed, removes member ownerships, demotes outside contributors and emails members; on AR error records failure and re-raises.

Q08.summary: For a newly created https link due for verification enqueues a verify job and returns self; otherwise, for https links with failures newer than the last verification, resets the failure counter.

Q09.summary: Maps a token to a mutant id: ordinal strings become integers, else the key's id, else the unique id whose key matches ignoring the line number, else the text itself.

Q10.summary: Builds per-scope dependency lists with resolved best-matching versions, renders JSON partials or HTML with reverse dependencies and breadcrumbs, and sets surrogate key and cache headers.

Q11.summary: Computes a truncated SHA256 fingerprint of the node types and non-node field values of all nodes walked under the given nodes.

Q12.summary: Walks the syntax tree collecting constant references (segments, line, nesting, enclosing scope), tracking class/module nesting and association-name strings, and returns the collected list.

Q13.summary: Returns an identity set of the seed nodes plus everything recursively reachable via slot children and the last statement of statement lists.

Q14.summary: Returns "name-version" by looking up the name and nested version.version scalars in the YAML gemspec tree.

Q15.summary: Builds a list of from->to package folding links (via superclass, mixin modules, suffix-stripped names, plurals), resolving chains to a canonical target and labeling each with the kind that produced it.

Q16.summary: Scores an unless node at nesting-adjusted cost, visits its predicate and body deeper, then scores any elsif/else chain.

Q17.summary: Flags File.open(name, read-mode) followed by read (block-pass, chained, or block) and autocorrects to File.read/File.binread(name).

Q18.summary: Clears the hash and copies all pairs from other with keys stringified.

Q19.summary: Checks if/else/then/end keywords of an if node for missing surrounding spaces and registers autocorrectable offenses.

Q20.summary: Parses options, runs a list of environment checks (config, framework, sources, tests, git, rails, coverage floor, suite loading/baselines), prints them, and returns 1 if any failed (or on usage error).

Q21.summary: Parses source, normalizes numbered params, applies the handler named by the directive's type, and unparses back to source, returning nil on any error.

Q22.summary: Sets surrogate key and cache headers and, if stale, renders the gem's compact index info with ETag/digest headers and byte-range support.

Q23.summary: Returns the parsed metadata hash for a key whose file exists under the base dir (path validated), or a default empty metadata on missing/invalid JSON.

Q24.summary: Creates a new registry for the operators and relative root, and fills it with mutation points found in the given source file.

Q25.summary: Returns a hash of status, body, headers and url, using nil/empty defaults when the response has not finished.

Q26.summary: Logs the response status at the configured level and optionally filtered headers and body.

Q27.summary: Parses a string response body as JSON (optionally preserving raw) when the content type matches, wrapping errors in ParsingError.

Q28.summary: Returns the registered middleware for key, lazily resolving constant names or procs under a mutex, or raises if unregistered.

Q29.summary: Rewrites the last kwargs/hash argument of a call by replacing pairs with the given key via the block (dropping nils), removing the hash if empty.

Q30.summary: Prints per-cop offense counts sorted descending with correctability info, then the total and offending file count.

Q31.summary: Forks a worker that overlays the mutant source and runs tests until one fails, then reads its JSON result over a pipe with a deadline and converts it to a verdict (timeout/unjudged/parsed).

Q32.summary: Expands source path patterns (warning on unused excludes, erroring on no matches) and, if changed files given, keeps only those changed.

Q33.summary: Removes the size characters immediately before the given node/range after validating it belongs to the current buffer.

Q34.summary: Forces parsing of all project files and returns the list of paths that failed to parse.

Q35.summary: For JSON-eligible requests with a body, sets the default content type and encodes non-string bodies with the configured encoder.

Q36.summary: Classifies a statement node: adds it to the removable list unless it overlaps live locations or must be kept, records defined method names, and recurses into declaration bodies.

Q37.summary: Copies each registry file, synthesized with mutant overlays, into outdir, recording each in a manifest which it returns.

Q38.summary: Prints the top method and class complexity tables (non-zero cognitive scores) with a note about withheld rows.

Q39.summary: Requires MFA when needed, otherwise marks the reset session verified if not active, sets the compromised flag and renders the edit form.

Q40.summary: Resolves constant segments to a unique registered path by searching the lexical nesting and (memoized) ancestor lineage for the longest known prefix, returning nil if skipped or ambiguous.

Q41.summary: Returns whether any of the user's GitHub organization teams has the given slug.

Q42.summary: Clears the progress display if the tally is incomplete, otherwise commits it.

Q43.summary: Loads config from --config file (erroring if missing) or the default path, normalizing scalar/list keys, validating ignore rules, and merging baseline ignore rules.

Q44.summary: Sets the user and confirmation token (issuing one if needed) and sends the confirmation mail, or logs a skip when no token.

Q45.summary: Yields source ranges of duplicate elements (grouping escaped octal sequences, skipping interpolations) within each regexp character class.

Q46.summary: Recursively finds returns in tail position of a method body and flags them, autocorrecting by removing the keyword (bracketing/bracing values) or replacing with nil.

Q47.summary: Encodes a non-string, non-IO request body as URL-encoded form params when the content type matches, then calls the next app.

Q48.summary: Runs git diff against the base ref, raising a DiffError (with shallow-clone hint) on failure, and returns the changed file names.

Q49.summary: Checks that an if's else keyword is aligned with its base keyword (registering autocorrectable offenses) and recurses into elsif chains.

Q50.summary: Keeps only findings whose referenced site paths are among the requested paths within project directories, or all when no paths given.

Q51.summary: Returns whether a call is cheap: no block, is a reader or literal-keyed lookup, not a chained receiver call, and not a clock call.

Q52.summary: Groups files by shared word lists into roll-call groups and turns each into a finding with package, digest, evidence files and details.

Q53.summary: Runs the block with a parallel manager (given, current or adapter default, warning if none), executing or running it, and restores the previous manager.

Q54.summary: Verifies the WebAuthn credential and, unless the user is blocked, signs them in with tracking, flash and redirect; otherwise renders the login page with an error.

Q55.summary: Returns whether the call's receiver is (or traces via local-variable writes to) a request-like variable call.

Q56.summary: Resolves patterns plus includes into .rb files, removes excluded ones (by resolution or fnmatch), and returns them sorted unique.

Q57.summary: Flags and autocorrects unnecessary backslash escapes in a regexp, considering character-class context, delimiters and allowed escapes.

Q58.summary: Returns sorted dependency edges between packages as [from, to, evidence count] triples.

Q59.summary: Flushes queued cops into the registry/department indexes and returns whether the name is a known department.

Q60.summary: Parses argv; for non-page modes layers config-file flags (and directories when none given), keeping each flag only if the combined argv still parses.
